candidates.text: How has your sleep changed since last week?
What has been getting in the way of sleeping?
How have your meals been since your sleep changed?
How has your mood been since we last spoke?
What has lifted your mood recently, even briefly?
Who have you spoken to this week?
Who have you turned to for support since last week?
What has helped you get through difficult moments this week?
When walking was not possible, what else helped?
What has been hardest to cope with since we last met?
What small step toward your course have you taken?
What would help you keep going with your plans?
